title: Nonzero function has a nonzero coefficient
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$ be a nonzero function. Then at least one coefficient in the algebraic normal form of $f$ is nonzero.
